name: notable-finance
description: Root commands for the Notable Finance frontend application and backend service.

scripts.bootstrap: npm run deps:frontend && npm run deps:backend
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n BE,FE -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:frontend && npm run typecheck:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
